reason: The retained KDE Firefox iframe10 short-word case recognizes Double Shift, then loses exact-layout handoff because a visible IBus candidate panel becomes a normal active xdg_toplevel with keyboard focus. GTK3 Wayland accept_focus flags have no implementation. A null-timer cancellation alone did not fix a legitimate nonempty hint map.
decision: Use KWin's existing acceptfocus window rule for the exact normal IBus popup class and default popup caption. First test the packaged rule only in the disposable native KDE session. Keep the direct GTK IBus client integration, panel visibility, original input actions and every foreground/owner guard. Never reactivate Firefox in response to a panel map or treat panel focus as application focus.

alternatives.option: Existing KWin acceptfocus policy for the observed IBus popup
alternatives.reason: Smallest change at the proven presentation failure; no new transport, timer, controller or binary build. Requires exact match and native evidence that the visible panel cannot acquire keyboard focus.

alternatives.option: Move Firefox from direct GTK IBus to compositor text-input
alternatives.reason: Supported native Wayland integration, but changes the client input route and invalidates existing surrounding-text adapter acceptance. Separate migration rather than a focus-only repair.

alternatives.option: Add a new nonfocus Wayland surface backend to upstream IBus
alternatives.reason: Addresses panel presentation directly, but adds dependencies, packaging and positioning work; excessive for the current isolated failure.

alternatives.option: Ignore panel focus or force application reactivation
alternatives.reason: Would bypass foreground authority or introduce a focus race; rejected.
